tools.name: search_centers
tools.description: Search Kidincare for licensed childcare centers, daycares and preschools in the United States. Filter by keyword, city, state or ZIP code. Returns name, address, phone, ages served and the Kidincare page for each center. Use get_center with a returned id for full details.

tools.name: get_center
tools.description: Get full public details for one childcare center by its Kidincare id: contact details, hours, ages served, capacity, license, programs and description.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities in a US state that have childcare centers on Kidincare, largest first, with how many centers each has and a link to its city page.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Kidincare's published parenting and childcare guides, such as how to choose a daycare or what to ask on a tour. Returns each guide's title, summary and link. Leave query empty for the newest guides.
